reasoning: This is the standard UI glyph for a keyboard Backspace / Clear button. Aside from rare hardware keyboard modding or UI software tickets about the backspace key itself, it is an interface control rather than a real-world task subject, and for general 'delete' tasks a trash can is much clearer.
